description: Browse recent memories, get statistics, or fetch one memory in FULL by id. Use action "get" with an id to pull a large/consolidated memory untruncated (list actions truncate content to 150 chars). Use to see what you remember about a project, review recent learnings, or check memory health.

action.description: recent=latest memories, stats=counts and health, by-category=filter by type, by-project=filter by project, get=FULL untruncated content of one memory by id (no vector search), triage=forget candidates (duplicates, old never-recalled notes) ranked by how little they would be missed — nothing is deleted.

category.description: Category to filter by (for by-category action).

feedback.description: Feedback signal; never treated as proof of correctness.

id.description: Memory id (required for action "get"). Returns that memory's full content untruncated — use to fetch a consolidated/large memory directly.

token_budget.description: Estimated token budget for context; default 1500.

name: memories
